用户更新返回规范化身份，成员查询使用同一身份。

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "user.update",
  "requestId": "user",
  "data": {
    "name": "alice",
    "email": " A@B.C ",
    "clientTimeMs": 100
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "user.update",
  "requestId": "user",
  "data": {
    "clientTimeMs": 100,
    "serverTimeMs": 1,
    "user": {
      "name": "alice",
      "emailHash": "5d60d4e28066df254d5452f92c910092"
    }
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "members.get",
  "requestId": "members",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "members.get",
  "requestId": "members",
  "data": {
    "onlineCount": 1,
    "users": [
      {
        "name": "alice",
        "emailHash": "5d60d4e28066df254d5452f92c910092"
      }
    ]
  }
}
